title: Agent generations cannot set PromptBox parameters - add a named-parameter layer to generation.submit
description: MPI-546 shipped generation.submit, but an agent can only inherit whatever the open project happens to be set to. It cannot choose a ratio, resolution, quality tier, turbo, style or batch for a specific generation. The goal: an agent is asked for a specific generation with specific settings on a specific model, and can do it. No UI reflection required - the PromptBox does not need to change to match, per Fabio 2026-08-12.
